correctness.rationale: The functorial reduced Swiatkowski comparison specializes at a one-essential-vertex star to A_Z⊗Sym^{n-1}E_Z -> Sym^n E_Z by multiplication. Its image is the ideal of independent linear differences e_i-e_m, the quotient is Z[z] and the kernel is free; the two-term complex has no higher homology. The Koszul exact sequence gives the integral syzygy presentation. Rationally E=1⊕A and degreewise multiplication A⊗Sym^q A→Sym^{q+1}A is surjective; by the characteristic-zero Pieri rule the kernel for q>=1 is S_(q,1)(A), and q=0 has zero kernel. The exact sequence yields χ=(f-1)h_(n-1)-h_n+1 and h generating product ∏(1-t^j)^(-c_j). Burnside averaging of marked-arm exponent-vector orbits yields the stated invariant generating series. Independently recalculated integer partitions for m=3..9: n=2,3,4 all zero, n=5 all one; the proof covers all m by the three m-regimes. The package verifier was read: its cubical setwise-fixed signed traces are a finite sign check only, not the all-m,n proof.
residual_risks: The essential functorial topological comparison is a published theorem, not independently reproved here. The cubical finite verifier is bounded (11 pairs) and cannot establish arbitrary m,n. No integral Schur-summand splitting is asserted.
